title: 执行三层
note_on_kind: 标准代码章（非 primer）：走 implementer 精简版 + lint_fidelity 全链。本章把 L0 的 GPU 执行臂上层放大：调度器扔过墙的差量指令（SchedulerOutput）在墙那头穿 Executor/Worker/ModelRunner 三层变成 kernel，再变回 ModelRunnerOutput 扔回来。Part V《GPU 不等 Python》开篇——先立『执行臂的骨架』，持久批次/固定地址归 ch18，编译与捕获归 ch19。
hook_suggestion: 「差量指令扔过墙之后，墙那头是谁在接？一次前向要穿 Executor/Worker/ModelRunner 三层——为什么拆三层而不是一层，GPU 却没被这趟 Python 之旅拖住？」（从 Part V hook『Python 写的 attention 变成 CUDA graph 重播的 kernel』+ 本章 l0_zoom『GPU 执行臂上层』+ deepread/gpu-exec why_chains[0]『三层解耦』、[2]『控制面/数据面分离』提炼；Part 级反问『为什么一个 GPU 引擎的大部分代码是 CPU Python』由 deepread first_read_suggestion 给出，本章以它开场、以三层解耦作第一个答案）
scope_note: 本章解读执行臂上层：EngineCore.step ②④ 两次调用之间发生的一切『控制面』事务。主线一（启动装配，站 1-6）= Executor.get_class 工厂分发 → mp 后端建 SHM 广播 MQ + spawn WorkerProc 子进程 → 子进程内 WorkerWrapperBase 延迟初始化（worker_cls 字符串 → 真类）→ Worker.init_device（分布式先于显存快照）→ Worker 生命周期三锚点（load_model / determine_available_memory / initialize_from_config，两个 CuMem 池 tag）。主线二（一拍穿越，站 7-13）= executor.execute_model 只是 collective_rpc 薄封装 → mp 一次 enqueue 广播全部 worker → worker_busy_loop dequeue getattr 派发 → Worker.execute_model（PP 接力）→ GPUModelRunner.execute_model 打包 ExecuteModelState 返回 None → bitmask 窗口后 executor.sample_tokens → 解包采样 → 只从 output_rank 收割、FutureWrapper FIFO 排空回 EngineCore。控制面/数据面分离（collective_rpc 契约）与两段式契约（None → sample_tokens）是本章两大 protocol 机制。边界：SchedulerOutput 差量协议的字段语义与 InputBatch 调和归 ch18；CustomOp/piecewise 编译/CUDA Graph/forward context 归 ch19；注意力后端归 ch21；slot_mapping/block_table 归 ch22；TP/PP/DP 通信全貌与 ray 后端归 ch34（本章 PP 只到 irecv/isend 接力一层）；显存 profile 的账本细节 ch14 已讲（本章只认三锚点的归属）；异步调度的调度器侧（batch_queue/影子状态）ch12 已立（本章只给 supports_async_scheduling 声明面）；spec decode drafter 装配归 ch33；Model Runner V2（vllm/v1/worker/gpu/，README 自述 experimental）全书锚定 V1 正典、V2 仅作展望脚注（gpu_worker.py:L174、L384-L423、README:L1-L3）。

key_classes.name: Executor
key_classes.responsibility: 执行器抽象基类——执行臂第一层，只答『在哪跑』。静态工厂 get_class() 按 distributed_executor_backend 分发（L47-L92）；__init__ 摊平 config 后把拉起 worker 的活留给 _init_executor() 抽象钩子（L95-L116）；execute_model/sample_tokens/initialize_from_config/compile_or_warm_up_model/determine_available_memory/add_lora/sleep/check_health… 全部引擎指令统一实现为 collective_rpc 调用（控制面唯一入口）；compile_or_warm_up_model 还把 worker 侧 CompilationTimes 汇回主进程取 max（L122-L137）。

key_classes.name: UniProcExecutor
key_classes.responsibility: 单进程执行器——控制面的最简形态：driver_worker（WorkerWrapperBase）就在本进程，collective_rpc 退化为 run_method 同进程直调；non_block 路径同步算完、把 AsyncModelRunnerOutput 包进 AsyncOutputFuture（延迟到 result() 才等 D2H 事件，L26-L42）；execute_model 覆写带 single_value=True 并在 non_block 下提前内联抛异常（L108-L121）；supports_async_scheduling=True（L145-L147）。

key_classes.name: MultiprocExecutor
key_classes.responsibility: 多进程执行器——1 个执行器进程 + N 个 WorkerProc 子进程的星形拓扑。_init_executor 建 rpc_broadcast_mq（SHM 广播 MessageQueue，L151-L157）→ spawn 全部 worker → READY 握手 → 监控线程（L279-L319）；collective_rpc 一次 enqueue 广播 + FutureWrapper 异步收回复（L354-L416）；execute_model/sample_tokens 覆写带 unique_reply_rank=self.output_rank 与超时（L321-L343）；shutdown 关 death_writer → graceful/SIGTERM/SIGKILL 三级 → 关全部 MQ（L470-L503）；weakref.finalize 兜底防泄漏（L113）。

key_classes.name: FutureWrapper
key_classes.responsibility: concurrent.futures.Future 子类：把『worker 回复尚未到达』包成 future。构造时 appendleft 进 futures_queue；result() 先 while 循环 pop 排空队列中先于自己的 future（底层 response MQ 是 FIFO，回复顺序=发出顺序，无需给每个 RPC 配 id）；_wait_for_response 里 aggregate（KV 输出聚合，PD 解耦用）后 set_result/set_exception，InvalidStateError 静默（L70-L100）。

key_classes.name: WorkerProc
key_classes.responsibility: 把一个 Worker 跑在独立子进程里的包装：__init__ 在子进程内经 WorkerWrapperBase 延迟初始化真 Worker 并完成 init_device/load_model（L607-L670）；worker_main 是子进程入口（信号→构造→READY 握手→busy_loop，L820-L944）；worker_busy_loop 是服役主循环（dequeue→getattr 派发→执行→output_rank 过滤回写，L997-L1022）；enqueue_output 把结果/异常转 (SUCCESS/FAILURE) 回 MQ（L946-L967）；monitor_death_pipe 让子进程感知父进程退出（L795-L818）；异步调度时 async_output_busy_loop 线程把 D2H 拷贝挪出主循环（L979-L995）。

key_classes.name: UnreadyWorkerProcHandle / WorkerProcHandle
key_classes.responsibility: 父进程侧对 worker 子进程的句柄（L530-L565）：进程对象、rank、ready_pipe、death_writer；READY 后从 handle 转成 WorkerProcHandle（附 worker_response_mq 与跨节点 peer_worker_response_mqs）。death_writer 由父进程持有——父进程退出时 death_reader 得 EOFError，子进程自清理（防孤儿 worker）。

key_classes.name: WorkerWrapperBase
key_classes.responsibility: 进程内对 worker 的延迟初始化包装（L187-L334）：构造只记 rpc_rank/global_rank（rpc_rank 是执行器内 rank，SPMD 多执行器时≠分布式 rank——docstring 自述）；update_environment_variables 先注入环境；init_worker 才按 worker_cls 字符串 qualname 解析真 Worker 类实例化（envs→插件→实例化的顺序硬约束；只收字符串、明确拒绝传类 L255-L259），可经 worker_extension_cls 动态注入基类扩展 collective_rpc 面（L261-L287）；mm 处理器 shm 接收缓存在此挂接（L295-L315）；__getattr__ 透传（L333-L334）——collective_rpc 的 getattr(self.worker, method) 由此命中；execute_model 覆写先 _apply_mm_cache（L346-L351）。

key_classes.name: WorkerBase
key_classes.responsibility: 硬件无关的 worker 接口（L39-L43 docstring 自述使命：'allows vLLM to cleanly separate implementations for different hardware'）——执行臂第二层的契约来源：init_device/load_model/execute_model/sample_tokens/get_kv_cache_spec/compile_or_warm_up_model/determine_available_memory… 全是纯虚；两段式契约钉死在 execute_model/sample_tokens 的 docstring（L142-L157：返回 None 则必须立刻调 sample_tokens，自注结构输出并行化重构时可能改变）。

key_classes.name: Worker
key_classes.responsibility: WorkerBase 的 GPU/CUDA 具体实现——设备生命周期的持有人：init_device（DP local_rank 修正→选卡→分布式先于显存快照→构造 runner，L303-L423）；load_model 套 CuMem 池 tag=weights（L435-L450）；determine_available_memory profile 定 KV 账（L459-L611，ch14）；initialize_from_config 在 tag=kv_cache 池内分配、先 ensure_kv_transfer_initialized（L649-L676）；compile_or_warm_up_model 启动期前移全编排（L678-L853）；execute_model/sample_tokens 包 runner 并持 PP 接力（L1010-L1107）；sleep/wake_up、weight transfer、profiler 等生产特性亦在此（本章不展开）。

key_classes.name: GPUModelRunner
key_classes.responsibility: 执行臂第三层——批次执行（只答『这一拍怎么算』）：execute_model 状态机（入口断言 L4171-L4175）+ 两段式（打包 ExecuteModelState L4516-L4527 → return None L4535；sample_tokens 解包即清 L4566-L4580 → bitmask → _sample L4582-L4589）。内部 _update_states/_prepare_inputs/_build_attention_metadata（差量调和、固定地址缓冲、metadata 构建）归 ch18-19；本章只立接口与暂存协议。全书锚定此 V1 实现（7928 行），vllm/v1/worker/gpu/ 的 V2 仍是 experimental。

key_classes.name: AsyncIntermediateTensors
key_classes.responsibility: PP 中间激活的懒同步包装（L96-L125）：非首 PP rank irecv 到的 tensor_dict + comm handles；__getattribute__ 拦截 .tensors 访问、首次访问才 wait_for_comm——PP 通信等待被推迟到真正要用中间张量之时，与异步调度重叠窗口配合。

key_classes.name: run_method
key_classes.responsibility: uni 直调的派发底层（L486-L514）：method 是 str→getattr(obj, method)（AttributeError 转 NotImplementedError）、bytes→cloudpickle 反序列化后 partial(fn, obj)、callable→直接调——与 mp 侧 worker_busy_loop 的三分支同构，『一个抽象两种拓扑』的最小证据。

why_chains.old_design: v0：LLMEngine 直接持有 executor→worker，worker 内焊死 GPU 逻辑，执行接口以 SequenceGroup 列表为中心。v1 起源 PR 6c5af09b3 "[V1] Implement vLLM V1 [1/N] (#9289)"（2024-10-22）才拆出 gpu_worker.py 与 executor/gpu_executor.py（git diff-filter=A 实证）；executor/abstract.py 工厂与 multiproc_executor.py 由 28b3a1c7e5 "[V1] Multiprocessing Tensor Parallel Support for v1 (#9856)"（2024-12-10）新增——Executor 抽象基类与 mp 后端同批落地。单层设计里『在哪台进程跑』『这块卡怎么初始化』『这一拍怎么算』是同一坨代码。

why_chains.old_design: v0：对每个 worker 单独 pickle-RPC（pipe 逐个发），命令和数据混在同一通道。
why_chains.pain: TP>1 时同一条指令要序列化 N 份、发 N 次；SchedulerOutput 若带全量请求状态则每拍 IPC 字节量随 batch 线性涨。

why_chains.cost: mp 模式下一个完整引擎拍 = execute_model + sample_tokens 两次 RPC 广播/收割；SchedulerOutput 仍需 pickle 一次广播（差量化后很小，但仍是每拍固定开销）；异步调度要求 executor 声明 supports_async_scheduling（uni/mp 均 True：uniproc_executor.py:L145-L147、multiproc_executor.py:L525-L527）且 EngineCore 侧用 batch_queue 流水（core.py:L625 起 step_with_batch_queue）。

why_chains.decision: 失败两路 + 关停三级：RPC 级错误走 MQ 回报，进程级死亡走 sentinel 监控；关停 graceful→SIGTERM→SIGKILL 且子进程能感知父进程退出
why_chains.old_design: （无对应旧设计——这是 v1 mp 后端与生俱来的可靠性设计；对照面是『worker 崩了引擎静默挂死』的朴素多进程服务。）
why_chains.pain: 多进程服务两类故障必居其一被漏掉：方法抛异常（进程还活着，要能把异常带回调用方）与进程被 OS 杀死（OOM/segfault，根本到不了 except）；父进程先退时子进程会变孤儿继续占 GPU。

def step(self) -> tuple[dict[int, EngineCoreOutputs], bool]:
        """Schedule, execute, and make output.

        Returns tuple of outputs and a flag indicating whether the model
        was executed.
        """

        # Check for any requests remaining in the scheduler - unfinished,
        # or finished and not yet removed from the batch.
        if not self.scheduler.has_requests():
            return {}, False
        scheduler_output = self.scheduler.schedule(self._should_throttle_prefills())
        future = self.model_executor.execute_model(scheduler_output, non_block=True)
        grammar_output = self.scheduler.get_grammar_bitmask(scheduler_output)
        with (
            self.capture_iteration_details(scheduler_output) as iteration_details,
            self.log_error_detail(scheduler_output),
        ):
            model_output = future.result()
            if model_output is None:
                model_output = self.model_executor.sample_tokens(grammar_output)

        # Before processing the model output, process any aborts that happened
        # during the model execution.
        self._process_aborts_queue()
        engine_core_outputs = self.scheduler.update_from_output(
            scheduler_output, model_output
        )
        self._attach_iteration_details(engine_core_outputs, iteration_details)

        return engine_core_outputs, scheduler_output.total_num_scheduled_tokens > 0

def start_worker_monitor(self, inline=False) -> None:
        workers = self.workers
        self_ref = weakref.ref(self)

        # Monitors worker process liveness. If any die unexpectedly,
        # logs an error, shuts down the executor and invokes the failure
        # callback to inform the engine.
        def monitor_workers():
            sentinels = [h.proc.sentinel for h in workers]
            died = multiprocessing.connection.wait(sentinels)
            _self = self_ref()
            if not _self or getattr(_self, "shutting_down", False):
                logger.debug("MultiprocWorkerMonitor: shutdown already initiated")
                return
            _self.is_failed = True
            proc = next(h.proc for h in workers if h.proc.sentinel == died[0])
            logger.error(
                "Worker proc %s died unexpectedly (exit code: %s), "
                "shutting down executor.",
                proc.name,
                proc.exitcode,
            )
            _self.shutdown()
            callback = _self.failure_callback
            if callback is not None:
                _self.failure_callback = None
                callback()

        if not inline:
            Thread(
                target=monitor_workers, daemon=True, name="MultiprocWorkerMonitor"
            ).start()
            return

        monitor_workers()

    def register_failure_callback(self, callback: FailureCallback):
        if self.is_failed:
            callback()

@staticmethod
    def worker_main(*args, **kwargs):
        """Worker initialization and execution loops.
        This runs a background process"""

        # Signal handler used for graceful termination.
        # SystemExit exception is only raised once to allow this and worker
        # processes to terminate without error
        shutdown_requested = threading.Event()

        def signal_handler(signum, frame):
            nonlocal shutdown_requested
            if not shutdown_requested.is_set():
                shutdown_requested.set()
                logger.debug(
                    "WorkerProc handling signal %d, raising SystemExit", signum
                )
                raise SystemExit()

        # Either SIGTERM or SIGINT will terminate the worker
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal_handler)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal_handler)

        # Publish the logical-to-physical mapping early so topology helpers
        # work before init_device (needed by set_worker_net_device below).
        assigned_physical_gpu_ids = kwargs[
            "vllm_config"
        ].parallel_config.assigned_physical_gpu_ids
        if assigned_physical_gpu_ids is not None:
            from vllm.platforms.interface import set_assigned_physical_gpu_ids

            set_assigned_physical_gpu_ids(assigned_physical_gpu_ids)

        # Set net device env vars for the worker if VLLM_GPU_NIC_PCIE_MAPPING is set
        set_worker_net_device(kwargs.get("local_rank", 0), kwargs["vllm_config"])

        worker = None
        ready_writer = kwargs.pop("ready_pipe")
        death_pipe = kwargs.pop("death_pipe", None)

        # Close inherited pipes from parent (incl. other worker pipes)
        # Explicitly passing in existing pipes and closing them makes the pipe
        # behave when using fork. Otherwise, a hidden reference to the pipes
        # exist in the child process and prevents EOF closure.
        for fd in kwargs.pop("inherited_fds", []):
            try:
                os.close(fd)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning("Error closing inherited connection: %s: %s", type(e), e)

        try:
            # Initialize tracer
            rank = kwargs.get("rank", 0)
            maybe_init_worker_tracer(
                instrumenting_module_name="vllm.worker",
                process_kind="worker",
                process_name=f"Worker_{rank}",
            )

            worker = WorkerProc(*args, **kwargs)
            assert worker.worker_response_mq is not None
            if kwargs["vllm_config"].parallel_config.numa_bind:
                numa_utils.log_current_affinity_state(f"Worker_{worker.rank}")

            worker.monitor_death_pipe(death_pipe, shutdown_requested)

            # Send READY once we know everything is loaded
            ready_writer.send(
                {
                    "status": WorkerProc.READY_STR,
                    "handle": worker.worker_response_mq.export_handle(),
                    "peer_response_handles": worker.peer_response_handles,
                }
            )

            # Ensure message queues are ready. Will deadlock if re-ordered.
            # Must be kept consistent with the Executor
            if worker.rpc_broadcast_mq is not None:
                worker.rpc_broadcast_mq.wait_until_ready()
            worker.worker_response_mq.wait_until_ready()
            ready_writer.close()
            ready_writer = None

            worker.worker_busy_loop()

        except Exception:
            # NOTE: if an Exception arises in busy_loop, we send
            # a FAILURE message over the MQ RPC to notify the Executor,
            # which triggers system shutdown.
            # TODO(rob): handle case where the MQ itself breaks.

            if ready_writer is not None:
                logger.exception("WorkerProc failed to start.")
            elif shutdown_requested.is_set():
                logger.debug_once(
                    "[shutdown] WorkerProc: exiting after shutdown request"
                )
            else:
                logger.exception("WorkerProc failed.")

            # The parent sends a SIGTERM to all worker processes if
            # any worker dies. Set this value so we don't re-throw
            # SystemExit() to avoid zmq exceptions in __del__.
            shutdown_requested.set()

        except SystemExit as e:
            # SystemExit is raised on SIGTERM or SIGKILL, which usually indicates that
            # the graceful shutdown process did not succeed
            if shutdown_requested.is_set():
                logger.debug_once(
                    "[shutdown] WorkerProc: terminated by shutdown signal"
                )
            else:
                logger.warning("WorkerProc was terminated")
            # SystemExit must never be ignored
            raise e

        finally:
            if ready_writer is not None:
                ready_writer.close()
            if death_pipe is not None:
                death_pipe.close()
            # Clean up once worker exits busy loop
            if worker is not None:
                worker.shutdown()

class WorkerWrapperBase:
    """
    This class represents one process in an executor/engine. It is responsible
    for lazily initializing the worker and handling the worker's lifecycle.
    We first instantiate the WorkerWrapper, which remembers the worker module
    and class name. Then, when we call `update_environment_variables`, and the
    real initialization happens in `init_worker`.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        rpc_rank: int = 0,
        global_rank: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Initialize the worker wrapper with the given vllm_config and rpc_rank.
        Note: rpc_rank is the rank of the worker in the executor. In most cases,
        it is also the rank of the worker in the distributed group. However,
        when multiple executors work together, they can be different.
        e.g. in the case of SPMD-style offline inference with TP=2,
        users can launch 2 engines/executors, each with only 1 worker.
        All workers have rpc_rank=0, but they have different ranks in the TP
        group.
        """
        self.rpc_rank: int = rpc_rank
        self.global_rank: int = self.rpc_rank if global_rank is None else global_rank

        # Initialized after init_worker is called
        self.worker: WorkerBase
        self.vllm_config: VllmConfig

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        if self.worker is not None:
            self.worker.shutdown()

    def update_environment_variables(
        self,
        envs_list: list[dict[str, str]],
    ) -> None:
        envs = envs_list[self.rpc_rank]
        update_environment_variables(envs)

    @instrument(span_name="Worker init")
    def init_worker(self, all_kwargs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        """
        Here we inject some common logic before initializing the worker.
        Arguments are passed to the worker class constructor.
        """
        kwargs = all_kwargs[self.rpc_rank]

        vllm_config: VllmConfig | None = kwargs.get("vllm_config")
        assert vllm_config is not None, (
            "vllm_config is required to initialize the worker"
        )
        self.vllm_config = vllm_config

        vllm_config.enable_trace_function_call_for_thread()

        from vllm.plugins import load_general_plugins

        load_general_plugins()

        parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
        if isinstance(parallel_config.worker_cls, str):
            worker_class: type[WorkerBase] = resolve_obj_by_qualname(
                parallel_config.worker_cls
            )
        else:
            raise ValueError(
                "passing worker_cls is no longer supported. "
                "Please pass keep the class in a separate module "
                "and pass the qualified name of the class as a string."
            )

        if parallel_config.worker_extension_cls:
            worker_extension_cls = resolve_obj_by_qualname(
                parallel_config.worker_extension_cls
            )
            extended_calls = []
            if worker_extension_cls not in worker_class.__bases__:
                # check any conflicts between worker and worker_extension_cls
                for attr in dir(worker_extension_cls):
                    if attr.startswith("__"):
                        continue
                    assert not hasattr(worker_class, attr), (
                        f"Worker class {worker_class} already has an attribute"
                        f" {attr}, which conflicts with the worker"
                        f" extension class {worker_extension_cls}."
                    )
                    if callable(getattr(worker_extension_cls, attr)):
                        extended_calls.append(attr)
                # dynamically inherit the worker extension class
                worker_class.__bases__ = worker_class.__bases__ + (
                    worker_extension_cls,
                )
                logger.info(
                    "Injected %s into %s for extended collective_rpc calls %s",
                    worker_extension_cls,
                    worker_class,
                    extended_calls,
                )

        assigned_physical_gpu_ids = kwargs.pop("assigned_physical_gpu_ids", None)
        if assigned_physical_gpu_ids is not None:
            vllm_config.parallel_config.assigned_physical_gpu_ids = (
                assigned_physical_gpu_ids
            )

        shared_worker_lock = kwargs.pop("shared_worker_lock", None)
        if shared_worker_lock is None:
            msg = (
                "Missing `shared_worker_lock` argument from executor. "
                "This argument is needed for mm_processor_cache_type='shm'."
            )

            mm_config = vllm_config.model_config.multimodal_config
            if mm_config and mm_config.mm_processor_cache_type == "shm":
                raise ValueError(msg)
            else:
                logger.warning_once(msg)

            self.mm_receiver_cache = None
        else:
            self.mm_receiver_cache = (
                MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY.worker_receiver_cache_from_config(
                    vllm_config,
                    shared_worker_lock,
                )
            )

        with set_current_vllm_config(self.vllm_config):
            # To make vLLM config available during worker initialization
            self.worker = worker_class(**kwargs)

    def initialize_from_config(self, kv_cache_configs: list[Any]) -> None:
        kv_cache_config = kv_cache_configs[self.global_rank]
        assert self.vllm_config is not None
        with set_current_vllm_config(self.vllm_config):
            self.worker.initialize_from_config(kv_cache_config)  # type: ignore

    def init_device(self):
        assert self.vllm_config is not None
        with set_current_vllm_config(self.vllm_config):
            # To make vLLM config available during device initialization
            self.worker.init_device()  # type: ignore

    def __getattr__(self, attr: str):
        return getattr(self.worker, attr)

        if self.device_config.device_type == "cuda":
            # This env var set by Ray causes exceptions with graph building.
            os.environ.pop("NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING", None)
            parallel_config = self.parallel_config
            if (
                parallel_config.distributed_executor_backend
                not in ("ray", "external_launcher")
                and parallel_config.data_parallel_backend != "ray"
                and parallel_config.nnodes_within_dp == 1
            ):
                # Use local DP rank if available, otherwise use global DP rank.
                dp_local_rank = self.parallel_config.data_parallel_rank_local
                if dp_local_rank is None:
                    dp_local_rank = self.parallel_config.data_parallel_index

                tp_pp_world_size = (
                    self.parallel_config.pipeline_parallel_size
                    * self.parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size
                )

                # DP_LOCAL_RANK * TP_PP_WORLD_SIZE + TP_LOCAL_RANK
                self.local_rank += dp_local_rank * tp_pp_world_size

            # Publish the logical-to-physical mapping for topology queries
            # such as NIC affinity and P2P checks.
            assigned_physical_gpu_ids = parallel_config.assigned_physical_gpu_ids
            if assigned_physical_gpu_ids is not None:
                from vllm.platforms.interface import set_assigned_physical_gpu_ids

                set_assigned_physical_gpu_ids(assigned_physical_gpu_ids)
                assert self.local_rank < len(assigned_physical_gpu_ids), (
                    f"local_rank {self.local_rank} is out of bounds for "
                    f"assigned_physical_gpu_ids {assigned_physical_gpu_ids}"
                )
                # NOTE(patch pr45026): local_world_size is derived from
                # parallel_config.nnodes, which is only set for the "mp"
                # multi-node backend. With the "ray"/"external_launcher"
                # backends nnodes stays 1, so local_world_size collapses to
                # the full world_size and this check wrongly fires on
                # cross-node deployments. assigned_physical_gpu_ids is already
                # per-node and the local_rank bound above fully validates the
                # mapping for these backends, so skip the check for them.
                if parallel_config.distributed_executor_backend not in (
                    "ray",
                    "external_launcher",
                ):
                    assert self.parallel_config.local_world_size <= len(
                        assigned_physical_gpu_ids
                    ), (
                        f"local_world_size ({self.parallel_config.local_world_size})"
                        " exceeds assigned_physical_gpu_ids count "
                        f"({len(assigned_physical_gpu_ids)})"
                    )
            else:

                    f"DP adjusted local rank {self.local_rank} is out of "

            )

theory.topic: 三层职责的正交性：两个变化轴为什么互不牵连
theory.detail: 进程编排轴（uni/mp/ray/external_launcher/自定义 qualname，枚举在 get_class 的 elif 链）× 硬件适配轴（worker_cls 字符串 → 平台插件解析，platforms/cuda.py:L312-L313）。加一种硬件 = 换 worker_cls 字符串，executor 代码零改动；换 ray 编排 = 换 executor 类，worker/runner 复用。第三问『这一拍怎么算』（ModelRunner）对前两问完全无感——它只认 (scheduler_output, intermediate_tensors) 签名，不知道自己跑在第几个进程。正交的代价 = 调用栈变深：一次 execute_model 要穿 executor 薄封装 → collective_rpc（uni 直调 / mp 广播）→ wrapper __getattr__ → Worker → runner，共 5 层间接。

theory.topic: 星形广播的 IO 账：一次 enqueue vs N 份 pickle
theory.detail: v0 逐 worker pickle-RPC：同一指令序列化 N 份、走 N 条 pipe，O(N) 发送；mp 的 SHM MessageQueue 让 N 个 reader 共享同一块广播数据，enqueue 一次 O(1)。应答侧不对称：广播 1 条 MQ、应答 N 条 MQ（每 worker 一条 MessageQueue(1,1)，multiproc_executor.py:L585）；execute_model 经 output_rank 把应答收敛回 1 条（只 dequeue response_mqs[output_rank]，L391-L392）。每引擎拍 mp 下共两次广播（execute_model + sample_tokens）+ 两次单点收割。SchedulerOutput 差量化保证广播字节不随 batch 线性涨（字段级差量的展开归 ch18）。

theory.topic: FutureWrapper FIFO 配对的正确性论证
theory.detail: futures_queue 用 appendleft 入队、result() 里 pop 出队（两端配合即 FIFO），与底层 response MQ 的 FIFO 同序。不变量：只要每个 FutureWrapper.result() 在取自己之前先排空队列中更早的 future（while not self.done(): future = pop(); future._wait_for_response()），就保证『第 k 个发出的 RPC 对应第 k 次 dequeue 的回复』——无需给每个 RPC 配 id 或独立通道。non_block 连发多个 RPC 时，后发的 future 在 result() 时顺手替先发的收尸，延迟被摊平。边界：timeout 未实现（result(timeout) 直接 raise）；aggregate 聚合只发生在 KV 输出场景（PD 解耦）。

worker 方法抛异常（进程活着）：busy_loop 的 except 捕获 → (FAILURE, str) 回 MQ → get_response 抛 RuntimeError——同步、可定位（add_note 带回子进程栈）、引擎可决策。worker 进程被 OS 杀死（OOM kill/segfault，except 根本执行不到）：sentinel 就绪 → 监控线程 wait 返回 → is_failed + shutdown + failure_callback——异步、致命。两路并存才既报『方法错』又报『进程没了』；只有前者则 OOM 后 collective_rpc 永久阻塞在 dequeue；只有后者则普通异常也整机下线。

theory.topic: 延迟初始化的时序约束为什么是硬的
theory.detail: 子进程继承父进程环境后，平台插件（load_general_plugins，worker_base.py:L245-L247）可能注册/覆盖平台实现，而 CUDA context 绑定在第一次 torch.cuda 调用上——若 Worker 类在环境变量（CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES 等）注入前实例化，import 期解析的设备与实际可见设备错位。因此 Wrapper 把『记住身份』（rpc_rank/global_rank）与『真正实例化』（init_worker）拆成两步，中间留出 update_environment_variables 与插件加载的窗口。worker_cls 只收 qualname 字符串（L255-L259 明确拒绝传类）正是为了让类解析发生在子进程、正确的插件环境里。
